INVITATION TO BID FOR THE CONSTRUCTION/REPAIR OF
CDC (CHILD DEVELOPMENT CENTER),
BRGY. SAN RAFAEL, MIAGAO, ILOILO
1. The Municipality of Miagao through the Budget for the Contract Approved by the
Sanggunian, Trust Fund - DSWD, Budget Year 2019 intends to apply the sum of P
263,340.00 being the Approved Budget for the Contract (ABC) to payments under the
contract for Supply and Delivery of Materials and Supplies for the
Construction/Repair of CDC (Child Development Center), Brgy. San Rafael, Miagao,
lloilo. Bids received in excess of the ABC shall be automatically rejected at bid
opening.
Z. The Municipality of Miagao now invites bids for the following:
ITEM
NO. QUANTITY | UNIT ITEM DESCRIPTION
1 320 bags _| portland cement
2 2D cu.m. | washed gravel
3 27 cu.m. | washed sand
4 270 pes 10mm x 6.0m steel bars
5 30 pes 12mm x 6.0m steel bars
6 40 pes 16mm x 6.0m steel bars
7 1400 pes _| 6" concrete hollow blocks
8 320 pes | 4" concrete hollow blocks
9 15 pcs 1/4" x 4'x 8' ordinary plywood
10 240 pcs 2" x 2" x 10' good lumber, rough
11 40 pcs bamboo poles, 4” @, more or less 30 ft.
12 30 kgs | #16 GI tie wire
13 8 kgs 1 1/2" common wire nails
14 8 kgs | 2 1/2" common wire nails
15 20 kgs | 3" common wire nails
16 10 kgs _ | 4" common wire nails
17 10 kgs — | 5" common wire nails
18 15 pes __| hacksaw blade
Delivery of the Goods is required fifteen (15) calendar days after receipt of Notice to
Proceed. Bidders should have completed within twelve (12) months, a contract
similar to the Project from the date of submission and receipt of bids. The description
of an eligible bidder is contained in the Bidding Documents, particularly, in Section II.
Instructions to Bidders.
